description: Web page to Markdown: reads a public URL and returns clean, LLM-ready Markdown with title, meta description and a token estimate; scripts, navigation and ads removed. max_chars 1 to 100000 (default 15000). Use when an agent needs to read a web page, an article or documentation. $0.001; empty results are free.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of Markdown to return; longer pages are truncated and marked as such.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) page URL to convert to Markdown; private addresses, unsafe redirects and credential-bearing URLs are rejected.

name: url_to_clean_markdown

outputSchema.description: Fields only; full schema in GET /v1/catalog.

title: Web Page to Markdown
